source: framework project brief canonical structure, 2026-10-19 (55 numbered subsections and 2 annexes)

kinds.reversible_hypothesis: stated with what confirms or reverts it

forbidden: an inference not stated in the same sentence
copying content another subsection owns (refer instead)
exit_check: every gap mark points to an open gap

evolution.policy: additive: a sub-block before a new number; never renumber, rename or merge; retired ids become tombstones and are never reused

line.es: N/A — el proyecto no tiene superficie de usuario propia. Si se suma una pantalla, aunque sea de operación, se abren §4, 5.19–5.23 y 5.12 (Estado de cliente).
line.en: N/A — the project has no user surface of its own. If a screen is added, even an operations one, §4, 5.19–5.23 and 5.12 (Client state) open.

line.es: N/A — no expone API (el versionado de layouts vive en 5.9). Si se agrega un endpoint de consulta o de disparo, se abren los dos sub-bloques y 5.18.
line.en: N/A — it exposes no API (layout versioning lives in 5.9). If a query or trigger endpoint is added, both sub-blocks and 5.18 open.

line.es: N/A — no reemplaza un sistema cuyas salidas haya que igualar. Si aparece uno, se abren 5.17 y 5.13 como obligatorias.
line.en: N/A — it replaces no system whose outputs must be matched. If one appears, 5.17 and 5.13 open as required.

line.es: N/A — un solo cliente o tenant. Si se suma un segundo, se abren 5.24 y la columna de tenant en 5.4.
line.en: N/A — a single customer or tenant. If a second one is added, 5.24 and the tenant column in 5.4 open.

line.es: N/A — sin exposición a usuarios externos ni canal público. Si se expone, se abre.
line.en: N/A — no exposure to external users or a public channel. If it is exposed, it opens.

line.es: N/A — no hay nada instalado que respetar: todo se crea en este proyecto. Si aparece un recurso, sistema o dato a reutilizar, extender o reemplazar, se abren.
line.en: N/A — nothing installed to respect: everything is created in this project. If a resource, system or data to reuse, extend or replace appears, they open.
